articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Text, Image, Audio, and Video
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that processes text, image, audio, and video inputs within a unified transformer architecture rather than separate encoder pipelines. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on MMLU-Pro and near-human performance on novel PhD-level science questions. The model also introduces a 1M-token context window as the default tier, with significant latency reductions via a new sparse mixture-of-experts inference stack.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2 with a focus on long-horizon agentic task completion, scoring 81% on SWE-Bench Verified and 74% on the new RE-Bench 2.0 for multi-step software engineering tasks. The model introduces persistent memory and tool-use planning layers that allow it to autonomously manage multi-file codebases over sustained sessions. Google is integrating it directly into an upgraded version of Project IDX and Vertex AI agent workflows.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 with 400B MoE Architecture and Multilingual Specialization
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 under a permissive open license, featuring a 400B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 52B active parameters per forward pass, dramatically improving inference efficiency. The model includes dedicated expert clusters for 28 languages and shows competitive performance with proprietary frontier models on reasoning benchmarks. The release includes quantized variants optimized for single-node deployment on 2×H100 setups, lowering the barrier for enterprise self-hosting.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Edition for Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial version of its electric Atlas humanoid robot, tailored for Hyundai's automotive manufacturing facilities. The robot demonstrates reliable manipulation of irregularly shaped parts, overhead tool use, and navigation across unstructured factory floors with sub-centimeter placement precision. Initial deployment covers three Hyundai plants in South Korea, with plans to expand to 12 facilities globally by mid-2027.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Household Task Generalization in Figure 02 with Foundation Model Integration
articles.summary: Figure Robotics showcased its Figure 02 humanoid performing a diverse set of previously unseen household tasks—including loading a dishwasher, folding varied clothing items, and organizing cluttered shelves—without task-specific fine-tuning. The system uses a vision-language-action foundation model trained on a proprietary dataset of 50,000+ manipulation demonstrations and real-time sim-to-real transfer. The company announced a pilot consumer leasing program slated for Q2 2027.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production on A14 2nm Node with Gate-All-Around Transistors
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its N2 process node, the company's first to use gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors, delivering an estimated 25% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over N3E. Initial production is allocated to Apple's next-generation M-series chips and Qualcomm's Snapdragon 9 Gen 1 SoCs. The ramp is on schedule despite earlier industry skepticism about GAA yield challenges at 2nm geometries.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with 4,096 Electrodes
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which quadruples electrode count to 4,096 channels and features a fully wireless bidirectional data link with on-chip signal processing. The expanded channel count aims to enable not just cursor control but high-fidelity speech decoding and rudimentary sensory feedback for paralyzed patients. Enrollment for a 30-patient trial is expected to begin in January 2027 across three medical centers.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework Adopted by EU AI Office
articles.summary: Anthropic published a formal Constitutional AI Oversight (CAIO) protocol for auditing frontier model safety, which the EU AI Office has adopted as a reference framework for compliance with the EU AI Act's high-risk system requirements. The framework specifies red-teaming methodologies, interpretability benchmarks, and continuous monitoring standards for general-purpose AI models. This marks the first time a major regulatory body has formally endorsed a specific AI safety evaluation methodology from an AI lab.
